verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is the MCP-driven follow-up flow, where Superhuman Mail sends each nudge at the time the recipient is most likely to open it. That is a deferred, timed send, but it is not a documented user-facing 'send later' control. The pack has no evidence of undo send, and the 'explicit approval' requirement for AI sends is a different control, not a post-send grace window. Missing for 10: documented user-chosen schedule-send in the composer, undo send with a configurable grace window, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send at the time each recipient is most likely to open it.
